description: Full French company file in ONE call, paying only for the blocks you ask for: for when you need several things about the same company and do not want to chain calls. The identity base is $0.01; add any of etablissements, alertes_bodacc, contentieux, finances, marches_publics, marches_publics_ue, lobbying, risques_industriels, agrements, pi, documents, facturation_prep, score. Each block costs exactly what its dedicated endpoint costs, and the total is capped at $0.35. Any block that cannot be served is NAMED with a reason from a closed list: aucune_donnee (a negative answer, e.g. no patents), non_diffusible (GDPR/partial disclosure), non_couvert (not a proven legal person), panne_amont (upstream register down), stock_perime (local copy past its age limit), collecte_en_cours (local stock empty or never loaded) or identite_incomplete (incomplete identity). For a verdict rather than raw blocks, use get_french_company_intelligence ($1.00). An identity whose administrative status or legal category is missing in Sirene is served with blocs_absents (raison identite_incomplete) and a partial provenance. Blocks built on it (score, facturation_prep) are absent for that reason (identite_incomplete). If no requested block is served and one is down, stale (stock_perime) or with its local stock empty or never loaded (collecte_en_cours), the call returns 503 (a retry may serve a down block); else if one is refused for that reason, 404 identite_incomplete; neither is charged. Asking for score on a sole proprietorship, a restricted-diffusion unit or a group without legal personality refuses the whole file: 400 with the exact code, never charged. Partial diffusion (rule diffusion_partielle_nom_retenu_et_compte): for a unit not proven to be a legal person, identite.denomination and every documents nom_document are null, counted in ecartes.diffusion_partielle; facturation_prep.destinataire.denomination is null, uncounted, and destinataire.information states the partial diffusion. Public procurement block: Names are served for legal persons proven by their Sirene legal category only: a sole proprietorship, a group of natural persons or a category in doubt never has its name served and keeps its SIREN or SIRET, the omissions counted without identity in ecartes, over the entries the response serves (rule R1). A contract subject that names a person by a civility followed by a capital letter (M., Mme, Monsieur, Madame, Maître…) is served null, counted without identity in ecartes; the contract stays (rule R1). Paid via x402 in USDC or EURC. When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

blocs.description: Comma-separated blocks, e.g. finances,pi,score. Available: etablissements, alertes_bodacc, contentieux, finances, marches_publics, marches_publics_ue, lobbying, risques_industriels, agrements, pi, documents, facturation_prep, score

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_company_file

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
